sloka: राक्षसानां च निनदैर्हरीणां चापि निस्वनैः ।सा बभूव निशा घोरा भूयो घोरतरा तदा ।। ६.४४.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ ca ninadairharīṇāṁ cāpi nisvanaiḥ ।sā babhūva niśā ghorā bhūyo ghoratarā tadā ।। 6.44.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The night which was fierce appeared more dreadful with the loud noise of Rakshasas and Vanaras.
